name: Spacecraft Atmosphere Monitoring
subtitle: MRN: 80-EJ
description: Monitors internal spacecraft atmosphere, oxygen/nitrogen ratios, and cabin pressurization.

name: Control
subtitle: VER: 80-KJ
description: Central system control, operational routing, and executive spacecraft subsystems.

name: Communications
subtitle: PMT: 26-07
description: Radio and deep-space telemetry links with Mission Control Earth and antenna pointing.

name: System Damage
subtitle: GPM: 72-KC
description: Hull breach detection, structural stress diagnostics, and unit failure warnings (e.g. AE-35 unit fault).

name: Flight Dynamics
subtitle: ATA: 48-12
description: Orbital mechanics, spacecraft attitude, attitude thrusters, and momentum vectors.

name: Guidance Data Extension
subtitle: LIF: 13-AG
description: Long-range trajectory calculations, interplanetary transfer orbits, and course corrections.

name: Hibernation
subtitle: STA: 35-05
description: Cryogenic pod biometrics, metabolic monitoring, and life status of hibernating crew members.

name: Life Support
subtitle: ATA: 61-08
description: Active environmental control, centrifuge gravity simulation, water recycling, and thermal regulation.

name: Memory
subtitle: PMT: 49-XB
description: HAL 9000 optical logic banks, cognitive associative memory status, and core storage integrity.

name: Navigation
subtitle: RTE: 09-EF
description: Stellar triangulation, celestial coordinate tracking, star charts, and Jupiter approach tracking.

name: Nuclear Reactor Status
subtitle: AQS: 64-VN
description: Nuclear propulsion core diagnostics, thermal radiator performance, and primary power generation.

name: Vehicle Status
subtitle: LIN: 86-QW
description: Overall spacecraft superstructure integrity, Pod Bay airlock cycles, and Discovery One hull telemetry.
